) shares rise over 3% premarket after Chair of the Board of Directors and Chief Executive Officer Dani Reiss said on September 9, 2026, through his investment holding company DTR, he has acquired an aggregate of 100,000 subordinate voting shares of the company through open market purchases.

Immediately before the acquisition, Reiss beneficially owned and exercised control and direction over 119,413 SVS and, through DTR, 20.13M multiple voting shares of Canada Goose, representing approximately 0.26% of the outstanding SVS.

Following the acquisition, Reiss, including through DTR, beneficially owns and exercises control and direction over 219,413 SVS, representing 0.48% of the outstanding SVS, and 20.13M MVS, representing 39.47% of the outstanding MVS.

Reiss also holds 2.54M options to acquire SVS upon exercise, 188,295 restricted share units, and 532,041 performance share units. Such MVS and SVS represent, in the aggregate, approximately 21% of all of Canada Goose’s outstanding shares and 36.28% of the votes attaching to all of Canada Goose’s outstanding shares.

The securities were acquired through the facilities of the TSX and other Canadian published markets at prices ranging from $10.555 to $10.695 per share for an average purchase price of approximately $10.623 and an aggregate purchase price of approximately $1,062,300.

title: Canada Goose rises after CEO buys additional company shares
